		<div class="detail">
			<strong>Genre:</strong> Weekend intensives <br/><strong>Open:</strong> 16:00 - 19:00 hrs<br/><strong>Tickets:</strong> € 150 early bird, 180 after August 30th 		</div>
		<div class="text">
			<p>After several requests, 4bid offers a new series of life drawing weekend intensives! This four-lesson weekend course covers all you need to know (or need a nudge to remember to put into practice) when it comes to model drawing. Over the 4 sessions (Friday to Monday, each 3h) you&#39;ll delve much deeper into the subject matter than in our regular 1,5h weekly appointments.</p>

<p>Under the tutor&#39;s guidance, you will cover composition, anatomy, and shading. In each lesson, you&#39;ll work with the same live model, to master the understanding of their shapes. You will be invited to immediately develop and own a personal style, focusing on chiaro-scuro and line work, and applying bold gesture onto the paper. On the last evening you&#39;ll further one drawing, finishing it by applying all the learned tools.</p>

<p>To get the most out of this course, it can be helpful to have taken part to a drop-in session at 4bid gallery on either Tuesdays or Sundays (see the regular meetups). It is however not required to have prior experience.</p>

<p>The suggested price is &euro;180 pp | 4 lessons of 3 hours | 8 participants max | Includes materials, coffee, tea, and snacks.<br />
If you have difficulties meeting this cost please let us know via email, and we can arrange something you are comfortable with:&nbsp;<a href="http://email@example.invalid./" target="_blank">email@example.invalid.</a></p>

<p>Classes are on Friday from 18:00 to 21:00, Saturday and Sunday from 16:00 to 19:00 and Monday from 18:00 to 21:00.</p>

<p>Location: 4bid gallery, Overtoom 301, 1054HW AMSTERDAM</p>
		</div>
